summary.text: Drew Robbins is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 84, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Republican primary.
He is a software consultant who has served in the U.S. Army Reserve, and he lists public safety, infrastructure and education among his campaign priorities.

paragraphs.text: Robbins graduated from Grayling High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Grand Valley State University in 2017.
He began serving in the U.S. Army Reserve in 2020, and his career experience includes working as a software consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a former president of the Grand Rapids City Commission, a U.S. Army Reserve veteran and a senior HRIS software analyst.

In the same survey, Robbins listed three key campaign messages: supporting first-responder professionals on public safety, prioritizing roads, bridges, parks, community centers and libraries, and keeping school curricula focused on practical, hands-on subjects.
